name: employee-inventory-management
description: Employee Inventory Management — root scripts for building and running both halves together.
comment: This file exists mainly so hosting providers detect a Node project at the
repository root. Without a package.json here, Render's build container has
no Node toolchain on PATH and the build dies with 'command not found'
(exit status 127) before it reaches frontend/ or backend/.
The scripts use `cd` rather than `npm --prefix`. --prefix changes the
working directory but does not put that package's node_modules/.bin on
PATH, so `npm --prefix frontend run build` fails with 'vite: not found'.
Order matters: the frontend must be built before the backend starts,
because the backend serves frontend/dist and only looks for it at

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm ci
scripts.start: cd backend && npm run setup && npm start
